summary: CNB Financial Corporation filed an 8-K on June 16, 2026 announcing the completion of a partial redemption of $50 million of its 3.25% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2031. The redemption occurred on June 15, 2026 at par plus accrued interest, leaving $35 million outstanding. This is a capital structure action reducing debt and future interest expense, with no premium or accretion. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory timeline is mentioned. Watch for potential further redemptions or balance sheet repositioning; the risk-arb angle is negligible as this is a unilateral issuer action.
